function ico(name, opts){
  opts = opts||{};
  const size = opts.size||20, filled=opts.filled||false, color=opts.color||'currentColor';
  const body = ICONS[name]||'';
  return `<svg width="${size}" height="${size}" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="${filled?color:'none'}" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">${body}</svg>`;
}
function setIco(id,name,opts){ const el=document.getElementById(id); if(el) el.innerHTML = ico(name,opts); }

function catIconMarkup(catId, size, color){
  const textGlyphs = {finance:'₹', math:'Σ'};
  if(textGlyphs[catId]) return `<span style="font-size:${size*0.85}px;font-weight:800;color:${color};line-height:1;">${textGlyphs[catId]}</span>`;
  const nameMap = {basic:'calculator', scientific:'flask', graphing:'trending', programmer:'code', health:'heart', datetime:'calendar', unit:'shuffle', special:'wrench'};
  return ico(nameMap[catId]||'calculator', {size:size*0.62, color:color});
}

let fbEnabled = false;
let fbAuth = null;
let fbDb = null;

function loadScriptOnce(src, timeoutMs){
  return new Promise((resolve, reject)=>{
    const s = document.createElement('script');
    let done = false;
    const timer = setTimeout(()=>{ if(!done){ done=true; reject(new Error('timeout: '+src)); } }, timeoutMs);
    s.src = src;
    s.onload = ()=>{ if(!done){ done=true; clearTimeout(timer); resolve(); } };
    s.onerror = ()=>{ if(!done){ done=true; clearTimeout(timer); reject(new Error('load error: '+src)); } };
    document.head.appendChild(s);
  });
}
async function loadFirebaseSDKs(){
  const base = 'https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.7.0/';
  await loadScriptOnce(base+'firebase-app-compat.js', 8000);
  await loadScriptOnce(base+'firebase-auth-compat.js', 8000);
  await loadScriptOnce(base+'firebase-firestore-compat.js', 8000);
}
function initFirebase(){
  firebase.initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
  fbAuth = firebase.auth();
  fbDb = firebase.firestore();
  fbEnabled = true;
}

function mapFirebaseError(code){
  const map = {
    'auth/email-already-in-use':'ఈ email తో ఇప్పటికే account ఉంది.',
    'auth/weak-password':'Password కనీసం 6 characters ఉండాలి.',
    'auth/invalid-email':'Email సరిగ్గా లేదు.',
    'auth/user-not-found':'Account దొరకలేదు. ముందు Create Account చేయండి.',
    'auth/wrong-password':'Password తప్పు.',
    'auth/invalid-credential':'Email లేదా Password తప్పు.',
    'auth/too-many-requests':'చాలా attempts అయ్యాయి, కొద్దిసేపు తర్వాత ప్రయత్నించండి.',
    'auth/network-request-failed':'Internet connection చెక్ చేయండి.'
  };
  return map[code] || code;
}

/* ============================================================
   AUTH MODULE — Firebase Auth + Firestore (LIVE)
   userData caches the Firestore user doc in memory so the UI can
   render synchronously; saveUserData() writes it back (debounced).
   ============================================================ */
let currentUser = null;   // firebase.auth().currentUser
let userData = null;      // cached Firestore doc: {name,email,phone,gender,qualification,memberSince,streak,points,history,favorites}
let saveTimeout = null;

function defaultUserData(name,email,phone,gender,qualification){
  return {
    name, email, phone, gender, qualification, memberSince: Date.now(), photoBase64: null,
    streak: { lastActiveDate:null, streakCount:0, highestStreak:0, minutesByDate:{}, totalMinutes:0 },
    points: 0, history: [], favorites: []
  };
}
function loadUserData(uid){
  return fbDb.collection('users').doc(uid).get().then(doc=>{
    userData = doc.exists ? doc.data() : defaultUserData(currentUser.displayName||'User', currentUser.email,'','','');
    favorites = userData.favorites || [];
    history = userData.history || [];
  });
}
function saveUserData(){
  if(!currentUser || !userData) return;
  clearTimeout(saveTimeout);
  saveTimeout = setTimeout(()=>{
    fbDb.collection('users').doc(currentUser.uid).set(userData, {merge:true})
      .catch(err=> console.error('Firestore save error:', err));
  }, 700);
}
function getCurrentUser(){
  if(!userData) return null;
  return { name:userData.name, email:userData.email, phone:userData.phone, gender:userData.gender, qualification:userData.qualification, memberSince:userData.memberSince };
}

/* ---- Profile photo upload: reads from gallery, resizes/compresses via
   canvas to a small square JPEG (keeps Firestore doc size small), then
   stores as a base64 data URL (no Firebase Storage setup required). ---- */
let pendingAvatarBase64 = null;
function handlePhotoSelect(event, context){
  const file = event.target.files[0];
  if(!file) return;
  const reader = new FileReader();
  reader.onload = function(e){
    const img = new Image();
    img.onload = function(){
      const size = 220;
      const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
      canvas.width = size; canvas.height = size;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      const scale = Math.max(size/img.width, size/img.height);
      const w = img.width*scale, h = img.height*scale;
      ctx.drawImage(img, (size-w)/2, (size-h)/2, w, h);
      const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.82);
      if(context==='ca'){
        pendingAvatarBase64 = dataUrl;
        const preview = document.getElementById('caAvatarPreview');
        preview.src = dataUrl; preview.style.display='block';
        document.getElementById('ICO_CA_AVATAR').style.display='none';
      } else if(context==='profile'){
        if(!userData) return;
        userData.photoBase64 = dataUrl;
        saveUserData();
        renderProfile();
        renderDashboard();
      }
    };
    img.src = e.target.result;
  };
  reader.readAsDataURL(file);
}

function doCreateAccount(){
  if(!fbEnabled){ alert('Server కి connect అవ్వలేదు. Internet చెక్ చేసి app మళ్ళీ తెరవండి.'); return; }
  const name = document.getElementById('caName').value.trim();
  const email = document.getElementById('caEmail').value.trim().toLowerCase();
  const phone = document.getElementById('caPhone').value.trim();
  const gender = document.getElementById('caGender').value;
  const qualification = document.getElementById('caQualification').value;
  const pw = document.getElementById('caPassword').value;
  const pw2 = document.getElementById('caPassword2').value;
  const errEl = document.getElementById('caError');
  errEl.style.display='none';

  if(caMode==='edit'){
    userData.name=name; userData.phone=phone; userData.gender=gender; userData.qualification=qualification;
    if(pendingAvatarBase64){ userData.photoBase64 = pendingAvatarBase64; pendingAvatarBase64 = null; }
    saveUserData();
    goTo('profileScreen');
    return;
  }

  if(!name || !email || !pw){ errEl.textContent='దయచేసి అన్ని fields పూరించండి'; errEl.style.display='block'; return; }
  if(pw.length < 6){ errEl.textContent='Password కనీసం 6 characters ఉండాలి'; errEl.style.display='block'; return; }
  if(pw !== pw2){ errEl.textContent='Passwords match కావడం లేదు'; errEl.style.display='block'; return; }

  const submitBtn = document.getElementById('caSubmitBtn');
  submitBtn.disabled = true; submitBtn.textContent='Creating...';

  fbAuth.createUserWithEmailAndPassword(email, pw).then(cred=>{
    currentUser = cred.user;
    userData = defaultUserData(name, email, phone, gender, qualification);
    if(pendingAvatarBase64){ userData.photoBase64 = pendingAvatarBase64; pendingAvatarBase64 = null; }
    favorites = []; history = [];
    return fbDb.collection('users').doc(cred.user.uid).set(userData);
  }).then(()=>{
    initStreakForUser();
    submitBtn.disabled=false; submitBtn.textContent='Create Account';
    goTo('dashboardScreen');
  }).catch(err=>{
    submitBtn.disabled=false; submitBtn.textContent='Create Account';
    errEl.textContent = mapFirebaseError(err.code); errEl.style.display='block';
  });
}

function doLogin(){
  if(!fbEnabled){ alert('Server కి connect అవ్వలేదు. Internet చెక్ చేసి app మళ్ళీ తెరవండి.'); return; }
  const email = document.getElementById('loginEmail').value.trim().toLowerCase();
  const pw = document.getElementById('loginPassword').value;
  const errEl = document.getElementById('loginError');
  errEl.style.display='none';
  if(!email || !pw){ errEl.textContent='దయచేసి Email మరియు Password ఇవ్వండి'; errEl.style.display='block'; return; }

  const loginBtn = document.querySelector('#loginScreen .authBtnPrimary');
  loginBtn.disabled = true; loginBtn.textContent='Logging in...';

  fbAuth.signInWithEmailAndPassword(email, pw).then(cred=>{
    currentUser = cred.user;
    return loadUserData(cred.user.uid);
  }).then(()=>{
    initStreakForUser();
    loginBtn.disabled=false; loginBtn.textContent='Login';
    goTo('dashboardScreen');
  }).catch(err=>{
    loginBtn.disabled=false; loginBtn.textContent='Login';
    errEl.textContent = mapFirebaseError(err.code); errEl.style.display='block';
  });
}

function doLogout(){
  if(!fbEnabled){ return; }
  tickSession();
  fbAuth.signOut().then(()=>{
    currentUser = null; userData = null; favorites=[]; history=[];
    goTo('loginScreen');
  });
}

  fbAuth.sendPasswordResetEmail(email).then(()=>{
    alert('Password reset link మీ email కి పంపాము. Inbox చెక్ చేయండి.');
  }).catch(err=>{
    alert(mapFirebaseError(err.code));
  });
}

/* ============================================================
   STREAK / SESSION TRACKING MODULE
   Reads/writes userData.streak (synced to Firestore via saveUserData)
   ============================================================ */
function todayStr(){ return new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10); }
function getStreakData(){
  return userData ? (userData.streak || {lastActiveDate:null,streakCount:0,highestStreak:0,minutesByDate:{},totalMinutes:0}) : {lastActiveDate:null,streakCount:0,highestStreak:0,minutesByDate:{},totalMinutes:0};
}
function saveStreakData(d){ if(userData){ userData.streak = d; saveUserData(); } }
let sessionStartTime = Date.now();
function initStreakForUser(){
  if(!userData) return;
  const d = getStreakData();
  const today = todayStr();
  if(d.lastActiveDate !== today){
    const yesterday = new Date(Date.now()-86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10);
    if(d.lastActiveDate === yesterday) d.streakCount = (d.streakCount||0)+1;
    else d.streakCount = 1;
    d.lastActiveDate = today;
    d.highestStreak = Math.max(d.highestStreak||0, d.streakCount);
  }
  saveStreakData(d);
  sessionStartTime = Date.now();
}
function tickSession(){
  if(!userData) return;
  const d = getStreakData();
  const today = todayStr();
  const elapsedMin = (Date.now()-sessionStartTime)/60000;
  sessionStartTime = Date.now();
  d.minutesByDate = d.minutesByDate || {};
  d.minutesByDate[today] = (d.minutesByDate[today]||0) + elapsedMin;
  d.totalMinutes = (d.totalMinutes||0) + elapsedMin;
  saveStreakData(d);
}
setInterval(tickSession, 30000);
window.addEventListener('beforeunload', tickSession);
function minutesToday(){ const d=getStreakData(); return Math.round((d.minutesByDate||{})[todayStr()]||0); }
function formatUsage(totalMin){ const h=Math.floor(totalMin/60), m=Math.round(totalMin%60); return h+'h '+m+'m'; }

function getPoints(){ return userData ? (userData.points||0) : 0; }
function addPoints(n){ if(!userData) return 0; userData.points=(userData.points||0)+n; saveUserData(); return userData.points; }
function getBadges(streak){
  const list=[];
  if(streak>=7) list.push('bronze');
  if(streak>=15) list.push('silver');
  if(streak>=30) list.push('gold');
  if(streak>=60) list.push('premium');
  return list;
}

function addHistory(id,result){
  history.push({id,result,time:Date.now()});
  if(history.length>80) history = history.slice(-80);
  if(userData) userData.history = history;
  addPoints(10);
  saveUserData();
}

function timeAgo(ts){
  const diff = Date.now()-ts;
  const mins = Math.floor(diff/60000);
  if(mins<1) return 'Just now';
  if(mins<60) return mins+' min ago';
  const hrs = Math.floor(mins/60);
  if(hrs<24) return hrs+' hours ago';
  const days=Math.floor(hrs/24);
  if(days===1) return 'Yesterday';
  return days+' days ago';
}
function initialsAvatar(name){
  const initial = (name||'G').trim()[0].toUpperCase();
  return `<span style="font-size:20px;font-weight:800;">${initial}</span>`;
}

function goTo(screenId){
  document.querySelectorAll('.screen').forEach(s=>s.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById(screenId).classList.add('active');
  document.querySelectorAll('.bottomNav .navItem').forEach(n=>n.classList.remove('active'));
  const navScreens = ['dashboardScreen','allCalcScreen','rewardsScreen','historyScreen','profileScreen'];
  if(navScreens.includes(screenId) || screenId==='categoriesScreen'){
    document.getElementById('bottomNav').style.display='flex';
    const highlightId = screenId==='categoriesScreen' ? 'allCalcScreen' : screenId;
    const navEl = document.querySelector('.bottomNav .navItem[data-target="'+highlightId+'"]');
    if(navEl) navEl.classList.add('active');
  } else {
    document.getElementById('bottomNav').style.display='none';
  }
  window.scrollTo(0,0);
  if(screenId==='dashboardScreen') renderDashboard();
  if(screenId==='rewardsScreen') renderRewards();
  if(screenId==='historyScreen') renderHistory();
  if(screenId==='profileScreen') renderProfile();
  if(screenId==='categoriesScreen') renderCatListFull();
  if(screenId==='allCalcScreen'){ renderChips(); renderAllCalcList(currentTabMode, document.getElementById('allCalcSearchInput').value); }
}

  }
  actWrap.innerHTML += `<div class="activityRow">
    <div class="arIcon" style="background:var(--purpleLight);">${ico('clock',{size:18,color:'#5B2CFF'})}</div>
    <div class="arBody"><div class="arTitle">Total Usage Time</div></div>
    <div class="arVal">${formatUsage(streakData.totalMinutes||0)}</div>
  </div>`;
  actWrap.innerHTML += `<div class="activityRow">
    <div class="arIcon" style="background:var(--purpleLight);">${ico('award',{size:18,color:'#5B2CFF'})}</div>
    <div class="arBody"><div class="arTitle">Reward Points</div></div>
    <div class="arVal">${getPoints()}</div>
  </div>`;
}

/* ============================================================
   REWARDS RENDER
   ============================================================ */
function renderRewards(){
  const d = getStreakData();
  const streak = d.streakCount||0;
  document.getElementById('rewStreakVal').textContent = streak+' Days';
  const earned = getBadges(streak);
  const badgeDefs = [
    {id:'bronze', name:'Bronze', days:7},
    {id:'silver', name:'Silver', days:15},
    {id:'gold', name:'Gold', days:30},
    {id:'premium', name:'Premium', days:60},
  ];
  const bWrap = document.getElementById('badgeRow');
  bWrap.innerHTML='';
  badgeDefs.forEach(b=>{
    const isEarned = earned.includes(b.id);
    bWrap.innerHTML += `<div class="badgeItem ${isEarned?'earned '+b.id:'locked'}">
      <div class="badgeCircle">${ico('award',{size:24,filled:isEarned})}</div>
      <div class="bName">${b.name}</div>
      <div class="bDays">${b.days} Days</div>
    </div>`;
  });
  const milestones=[7,15,30,60];
  let nextM = milestones.find(m=>m>streak);
  if(!nextM){
    document.getElementById('premRewardTitle').textContent='Premium Unlocked! 🎉';
    document.getElementById('premRewardSub').textContent='You reached the 60-day Premium milestone.';
    document.getElementById('premProgressFill').style.width='100%';
    document.getElementById('premProgressLabel').textContent='60 / 60 Days';
  } else {
    document.getElementById('premRewardTitle').textContent = nextM+' Days Reward';
    document.getElementById('premRewardSub').textContent = 'You are '+(nextM-streak)+' days away from the next reward.';
    document.getElementById('premProgressFill').style.width = Math.min((streak/nextM)*100,100)+'%';
    document.getElementById('premProgressLabel').textContent = streak+' / '+nextM+' Days';
  }
  document.getElementById('rewTotalPoints').innerHTML = getPoints()+' '+ico('star',{size:16,filled:true,color:'#F5B301'});
  document.getElementById('rewBadgeCount').innerHTML = earned.length+' '+ico('award',{size:16,color:'#5B2CFF'});
  document.getElementById('rewMinutesToday').innerHTML = minutesToday()+' '+ico('clock',{size:16,color:'#5B2CFF'});
  const todayCount = history.filter(h=> new Date(h.time).toISOString().slice(0,10)===todayStr()).length;
  document.getElementById('rewCalcsToday').innerHTML = todayCount+' '+ico('calculator',{size:16,color:'#5B2CFF'});
}

/* ============================================================
   HISTORY RENDER
   ============================================================ */
function renderHistory(){
  const filterEl = document.getElementById('historyFilter');
  const filter = filterEl ? filterEl.value : 'all';
  const wrap = document.getElementById('historyList');
  wrap.innerHTML='';
  let list = history.slice().reverse();
  if(filter !== 'all') list = list.filter(h=>{ const c=CALCULATORS.find(x=>x.id===h.id); return c && c.cat===filter; });
  if(list.length===0){ wrap.innerHTML = `<div style="padding:30px;text-align:center;color:var(--textlight);font-size:13px;">ఇంకా history లేదు</div>`; return; }
  list.forEach(h=>{
    const c = CALCULATORS.find(x=>x.id===h.id); if(!c) return;
    const cat = catInfo(c.cat);
    const dt = new Date(h.time);
    const dateStr = dt.toLocaleDateString('en-IN',{day:'numeric',month:'short',year:'numeric'});
    const timeStr = dt.toLocaleTimeString('en-IN',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});
    wrap.innerHTML += `<div class="historyRow" onclick="openCalc('${c.id}')">
      <div class="hrIcon" style="background:${cat.light}">${catIconMarkup(c.cat,40,cat.color)}</div>
      <div class="hrBody"><div class="hrTitle">${c.name}</div><div class="hrSub">${dateStr} • ${timeStr}</div></div>
      <div class="hrVal">${h.result}</div>
    </div>`;
  });
}

/* ============================================================
   PROFILE RENDER
   ============================================================ */
function renderProfile(){
  const user = getCurrentUser();
  const d = getStreakData();
  if(!user){
    document.getElementById('profName').textContent='Guest User';
    document.getElementById('profEmail').textContent='Not logged in';
    ['pfName','pfEmail','pfPhone','pfGender','pfQual','pfMember'].forEach(id=>{ document.getElementById(id).textContent='--'; });
  } else {
    document.getElementById('profName').textContent=user.name;
    document.getElementById('profEmail').textContent=user.email;
    document.getElementById('pfName').textContent=user.name;
    document.getElementById('pfEmail').textContent=user.email;
    document.getElementById('pfPhone').textContent=user.phone||'--';
    document.getElementById('pfGender').textContent=user.gender||'--';
    document.getElementById('pfQual').textContent=user.qualification||'--';
    document.getElementById('pfMember').textContent = new Date(user.memberSince).toLocaleDateString('en-IN',{day:'numeric',month:'short',year:'numeric'});
  }
  const avatarInner = (userData && userData.photoBase64)
    ? `<img src="${userData.photoBase64}" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;border-radius:50%;">`
    : (user?initialsAvatar(user.name):ico('user',{size:28,color:'#fff'}));
  document.getElementById('profileAvatarWrap').innerHTML = avatarInner + `<div class="pCam">${ico('camera',{size:13,color:'#5B2CFF'})}</div>`;
  document.getElementById('pfStreak').innerHTML = (d.streakCount||0)+' Days '+ico('flame',{size:14,filled:true,color:'#F59E0B'});
  document.getElementById('pfHighStreak').textContent = (d.highestStreak||0)+' Days';
  document.getElementById('pfUsage').textContent = formatUsage(d.totalMinutes||0);
  document.getElementById('pfPoints').textContent = getPoints();
  document.getElementById('smName').textContent = user?user.name:'Guest User';
  document.getElementById('smEmail').textContent = user?user.email:'Not logged in';
  const smAvatarEl = document.getElementById('ICO_SM_AVATAR');
  if(smAvatarEl){
    smAvatarEl.innerHTML = (userData && userData.photoBase64)
      ? `<img src="${userData.photoBase64}" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;border-radius:50%;">`
      : ico('user',{size:22,color:'#fff'});
  }
}

document.querySelectorAll('#calcTabsRow .tabItem').forEach(tab=>{
  tab.onclick = () => {
    document.querySelectorAll('#calcTabsRow .tabItem').forEach(t=>t.classList.remove('active'));
    tab.classList.add('active');
    currentTabMode = tab.dataset.tab;
    renderAllCalcList(currentTabMode, document.getElementById('allCalcSearchInput').value);
  };
});

function renderAllCalcList(tabMode, query){
  query = (query||'').toLowerCase();
  const wrap = document.getElementById('allCalcList');
  let list = currentCategoryFilter==='all'||!currentCategoryFilter ? CALCULATORS : CALCULATORS.filter(c=>c.cat===currentCategoryFilter);
  if(tabMode==='favorite') list = list.filter(c=>favorites.includes(c.id));
  if(tabMode==='recent'){ const recentIds=[...new Set(history.map(h=>h.id))].reverse().slice(0,10); list = list.filter(c=>recentIds.includes(c.id)); }
  if(tabMode==='popular') list = list.slice(0,10);
  if(query) list = list.filter(c=>c.name.toLowerCase().includes(query) || c.desc.toLowerCase().includes(query));
  wrap.innerHTML = '';
  if(list.length===0){ wrap.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:30px;text-align:center;color:var(--textlight);font-size:13px;">ఏమీ లేదు</div>'; return; }
  list.forEach(c=>{
    const cat = catInfo(c.cat);
    const isFav = favorites.includes(c.id);
    wrap.innerHTML += `<div class="listRow" onclick="openCalc('${c.id}')">
      <div class="rIcon" style="background:${cat.light}">${catIconMarkup(c.cat,44,cat.color)}</div>
      <div class="rBody"><div class="rTitle">${c.name}</div><div class="rSub">${c.desc}</div></div>
      <div class="starBtn ${isFav?'active':''}" onclick="event.stopPropagation();toggleFav('${c.id}')">${ico('star',{size:19,filled:isFav})}</div>
    </div>`;
  });
}

function toggleFav(id){
  if(favorites.includes(id)) favorites = favorites.filter(f=>f!==id);
  else favorites.push(id);
  if(userData) userData.favorites = favorites;
  saveUserData();
  renderAllCalcList(currentTabMode, document.getElementById('allCalcSearchInput')?document.getElementById('allCalcSearchInput').value:'');
  if(currentCalcId===id) updateFavBtn();
}
function toggleCurrentFav(){ if(currentCalcId) toggleFav(currentCalcId); }
function updateFavBtn(){
  const btn = document.getElementById('calcFavBtn');
  if(!btn) return;
  const isFav = favorites.includes(currentCalcId);
  btn.innerHTML = ico('star',{size:20,filled:isFav,color: isFav ? '#F5B301' : (document.getElementById('calcDetailTopbar').classList.contains('colored') ? '#fff' : 'currentColor')});
}

/* ============================================================
   OPEN CALCULATOR DETAIL
   ============================================================ */
function openCalc(id){
  const c = CALCULATORS.find(x=>x.id===id);
  if(!c) return;
  currentCalcId = id;
  document.getElementById('calcDetailTitle').textContent = c.name;
  const cat = catInfo(c.cat);
  const topbar = document.getElementById('calcDetailTopbar');
  const specialColors = {emi:'purple', bmi:'teal', currency:'blue', breakdown:'purple'};
  topbar.classList.remove('colored','purple','blue','teal');
  if(specialColors[c.render]){ topbar.classList.add('colored', specialColors[c.render]); }
  const extras = document.getElementById('calcTopbarExtras');
  extras.innerHTML = `<button class="iconBtn" id="calcFavBtn" onclick="toggleCurrentFav()"></button>`;
  updateFavBtn();

  const body = document.getElementById('calcDetailBody');
  body.innerHTML = '';
  const themeColor = specialColors[c.render] ? {purple:'#5B2CFF',blue:'#3B82F6',teal:'#0FA98F'}[specialColors[c.render]] : cat.color;

  if(c.render==='keypad-basic') renderKeypadBasic(body);
  else if(c.render==='keypad-sci') renderKeypadSci(body);
  else if(c.render==='bmi') renderBMI(body);
  else if(c.render==='percentage') renderPercentage(body);
  else if(c.render==='currency') renderCurrency(body);
  else if(c.render==='converter') renderConverter(body,c);
  else if(c.render==='converter-temp') renderConverterTemp(body);
  else if(c.render==='emi') renderEMI(body);
  else if(c.render==='breakdown') renderBreakdown(body,c,themeColor);
  else if(c.render==='countdown') renderCountdown(body);
  else if(c.render==='graph') renderGraph(body);
  else if(c.render==='programmer') renderProgrammer(body);
  else renderGeneric(body,c);

  goTo('calcDetailScreen');
}

function renderGeneric(body, c){
  let html = '';
  c.fields.forEach(f=>{
    if(f.t==='select'){
      html += `<div class="field"><label>${f.l}</label><select id="f_${f.k}">`;
      f.opts.forEach(o=> html += `<option value="${o[0]}" ${f.def==o[0]?'selected':''}>${o[1]}</option>`);
      html += `</select></div>`;
    } else {
      html += `<div class="field"><label>${f.l}</label><input type="${f.t}" id="f_${f.k}" placeholder="${f.ph||''}" value="${f.def!==undefined?f.def:''}"></div>`;
    }
  });
  html += `<div class="btnRow"><button class="btnClear" onclick="clearGeneric('${c.id}')">Clear</button><button class="btnCalc" onclick="runGeneric('${c.id}')">Calculate</button></div>`;
  html += `<div class="resultBox" id="genResultBox"><div class="rLabel">Result</div><div class="rValue" id="genResultValue"></div><div class="rDetail" id="genResultDetail"></div></div>`;
  body.innerHTML = html;
}
function clearGeneric(id){ const c=CALCULATORS.find(x=>x.id===id); c.fields.forEach(f=>{ const el=document.getElementById('f_'+f.k); if(el) el.value = f.def!==undefined?f.def:''; }); document.getElementById('genResultBox').style.display='none'; }
function runGeneric(id){
  const c = CALCULATORS.find(x=>x.id===id);
  const v = {};
  c.fields.forEach(f=>{
    const el = document.getElementById('f_'+f.k);
    v[f.k] = f.t==='number' ? parseFloat(el.value||0) : el.value;
  });
  try{
    const r = c.compute(v);
    document.getElementById('genResultValue').textContent = r.value;
    document.getElementById('genResultDetail').textContent = r.detail || '';
    document.getElementById('genResultBox').style.display='block';
    addHistory(id, r.value);
  }catch(e){ document.getElementById('genResultValue').textContent='Error'; document.getElementById('genResultDetail').textContent='దయచేసి అన్ని values సరిగ్గా ఇవ్వండి'; document.getElementById('genResultBox').style.display='block'; }
}

function renderPercentage(body){
  body.innerHTML = `
    <div class="segTabs"><button class="active">Basic</button><button>Percentage</button></div>
    <div class="field"><label>What is</label><input type="number" id="pctX" placeholder="25"></div>
    <div class="field"><label>of</label><input type="number" id="pctY" placeholder="800"></div>
    <div class="field"><label>Result</label><input type="text" id="pctResultField" readonly placeholder="0"></div>
    <div class="btnRow"><button class="btnClear" onclick="document.getElementById('pctX').value='';document.getElementById('pctY').value='';document.getElementById('pctResultField').value='';document.getElementById('pctFormula').textContent='';">Clear</button>
    <button class="btnCalc" onclick="calcPct()">Calculate</button></div>
    <div class="formulaBox"><b>Formula</b><div id="pctFormula" style="margin-top:6px;"></div></div>`;
}
function calcPct(){
  const x = parseFloat(document.getElementById('pctX').value);
  const y = parseFloat(document.getElementById('pctY').value);
  if(isNaN(x)||isNaN(y)) return;
  const result = (x/100)*y;
  document.getElementById('pctResultField').value = result;
  document.getElementById('pctFormula').textContent = `Result = ( Value × Percent ) / 100  →  (${y} × ${x}) / 100 = ${result}`;
  addHistory('percentage', x+'% of '+y+' = '+result);
}

let bmiUnitMode = 'metric';
function renderBMI(body){
  body.innerHTML = `
    <div class="segTabs teal"><button class="active" onclick="setBmiUnit('metric',this)">Metric</button><button onclick="setBmiUnit('us',this)">US Units</button></div>
    <div class="field"><label>Height</label><div class="inputWrap"><input type="number" id="bmiHeight" placeholder="170"><span class="unitTag" id="bmiHUnit">cm</span></div></div>
    <div class="field"><label>Weight</label><div class="inputWrap"><input type="number" id="bmiWeight" placeholder="65"><span class="unitTag" id="bmiWUnit">kg</span></div></div>
    <div class="bmiResultCard" id="bmiCard">
      <div class="blabel">Your BMI</div><div class="bnumber" id="bmiNum">--</div><div class="bcat" id="bmiCat">--</div>
      <div class="bmiGaugeBar"><div class="marker" id="bmiMarker" style="left:0%;"></div></div>
      <div class="bmiScaleLabels"><span>&lt;18.5</span><span>18.5–24.9</span><span>25–29.9</span><span>≥30</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="bmiInfoBox" id="bmiInfoBox" style="display:none;">
      <div class="bTitle">BMI Category</div><div class="bCatName" id="bmiInfoCat">--</div><div class="bRange">Healthy BMI range: 18.5 – 24.9</div>
    </div>
    <button class="btnCalc teal" style="width:100%;" onclick="calcBMI()">Calculate</button>`;
  bmiUnitMode = 'metric';
}
function setBmiUnit(mode, el){
  bmiUnitMode = mode;
  document.querySelectorAll('.segTabs.teal button').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));
  el.classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('bmiHUnit').textContent = mode==='metric' ? 'cm' : 'in';
  document.getElementById('bmiWUnit').textContent = mode==='metric' ? 'kg' : 'lb';
}
function calcBMI(){
  let h = parseFloat(document.getElementById('bmiHeight').value);
  let w = parseFloat(document.getElementById('bmiWeight').value);
  if(!h||!w) return;
  if(bmiUnitMode==='us'){ h = h*2.54; w = w*0.453592; }
  h = h/100;
  const bmi = (w/(h*h));
  let cat='Normal', pos=50;
  if(bmi<18.5){cat='Underweight';pos=(bmi/18.5)*25;}
  else if(bmi<25){cat='Normal';pos=25+((bmi-18.5)/6.5)*25;}
  else if(bmi<30){cat='Overweight';pos=50+((bmi-25)/5)*25;}
  else {cat='Obese';pos=Math.min(75+((bmi-30)/10)*25,98);}
  document.getElementById('bmiNum').textContent = bmi.toFixed(2);
  document.getElementById('bmiCat').textContent = cat;
  document.getElementById('bmiMarker').style.left = pos+'%';
  document.getElementById('bmiCard').style.display='block';
  document.getElementById('bmiInfoBox').style.display='block';
  document.getElementById('bmiInfoCat').textContent = cat+' Weight';
  addHistory('bmi', bmi.toFixed(2)+' ('+cat+')');
}

let emiLastResult = null;
function updateEMICardLabel(mode){
  if(!emiLastResult) return;
  if(mode==='monthly'){ document.getElementById('emiCardLabel').textContent='Your Monthly EMI'; document.getElementById('emiCardVal').textContent='₹'+emiLastResult.emi.toFixed(0); }
  else { document.getElementById('emiCardLabel').textContent='Total Payment'; document.getElementById('emiCardVal').textContent='₹'+emiLastResult.total.toFixed(0); }
}
function resetEMI(){
  document.getElementById('emiPrincipal').value='';
  document.getElementById('emiRate').value='';
  document.getElementById('emiCard').style.display='none';
  document.getElementById('emiDonutCard').style.display='none';
  emiLastResult=null;
}
function calcEMIFull(){
  const p = parseFloat(document.getElementById('emiPrincipal').value);
  const annualRate = parseFloat(document.getElementById('emiRate').value);
  const years = parseFloat(document.getElementById('emiTenure').value);
  if(!p||!annualRate||!years) return;
  const r = annualRate/12/100, n = years*12;
  const emi = (p*r*Math.pow(1+r,n))/(Math.pow(1+r,n)-1);
  const total = emi*n; const interest = total-p;
  emiLastResult = {emi,total,interest,principal:p};
  const activeTab = document.querySelector('#emiTabsRow .tabItem.active').dataset.emitab;
  updateEMICardLabel(activeTab);
  document.getElementById('emiInterestVal').textContent = '₹'+interest.toFixed(0);
  document.getElementById('emiTotalVal').textContent = '₹'+total.toFixed(0);
  document.getElementById('emiCard').style.display='block';
  document.getElementById('emiDonutCard').style.display='block';
  const pPct = (p/total)*100, iPct=(interest/total)*100;
  document.getElementById('legendPrincipal').textContent = pPct.toFixed(1)+'% (₹'+p.toFixed(0)+')';
  document.getElementById('legendInterest').textContent = iPct.toFixed(1)+'% (₹'+interest.toFixed(0)+')';
  drawDonut('emiDonut', [{val:p,color:'#5B2CFF'},{val:interest,color:'#C7B8FA'}]);
  addHistory('emi', '₹'+emi.toFixed(0)+'/month');
}
function drawDonut(canvasId, segments){
  const canvas = document.getElementById(canvasId);
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const w=canvas.width,h=canvas.height,cx=w/2,cy=h/2,radius=w/2-8,lineWidth=16;
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
  const total = segments.reduce((a,s)=>a+s.val,0);
  let start=-Math.PI/2;
  segments.forEach(s=>{
    const angle = (s.val/total)*Math.PI*2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,radius,start,start+angle);
    ctx.strokeStyle=s.color; ctx.lineWidth=lineWidth; ctx.lineCap='butt'; ctx.stroke();
    start+=angle;
  });
}

function renderBreakdown(body,c,color){
  let html='';
  c.fields.forEach(f=>{
    if(f.t==='select'){
      html += `<div class="field"><label>${f.l}</label><select id="f_${f.k}">`;
      f.opts.forEach(o=> html += `<option value="${o[0]}" ${f.def==o[0]?'selected':''}>${o[1]}</option>`);
      html += `</select></div>`;
    } else {
      html += `<div class="field"><label>${f.l}</label><input type="${f.t}" id="f_${f.k}" value="${f.def!==undefined?f.def:''}"></div>`;
    }
  });
  html += `<div class="resultBox" id="bdBox" style="background:${hexToRgba(color,0.1)};border-color:${hexToRgba(color,0.35)};">
    <div class="rLabel" id="bdLabel" style="color:${color}">Result</div>
    <div class="rValue" id="bdValue" style="color:${color}">--</div>
    <div id="bdRows" style="margin-top:10px;"></div>
  </div>
  <button class="btnCalc" style="width:100%;background:${color};" onclick="runBreakdown('${c.id}')">Calculate</button>`;
  body.innerHTML = html;
}
function hexToRgba(hex,alpha){ const f=parseInt(hex.slice(1),16); const R=f>>16,G=(f>>8)&255,B=f&255; return `rgba(${R},${G},${B},${alpha})`; }
function runBreakdown(id){
  const c = CALCULATORS.find(x=>x.id===id);
  const v = {};
  c.fields.forEach(f=>{ const el=document.getElementById('f_'+f.k); v[f.k]= f.t==='number'?parseFloat(el.value||0):el.value; });
  try{
    const r = c.compute(v);
    document.getElementById('bdLabel').textContent = r.detail || 'Result';
    document.getElementById('bdValue').textContent = r.value;
    let rowsHtml='';
    (r.rows||[]).forEach(row=> rowsHtml += `<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:12.5px;padding:6px 0;color:var(--textlight);"><span>${row[0]}</span><span style="font-weight:700;color:var(--text);">${row[1]}</span></div>`);
    document.getElementById('bdRows').innerHTML = rowsHtml;
    document.getElementById('bdBox').style.display='block';
    addHistory(id, r.value);
  }catch(e){ document.getElementById('bdValue').textContent='Error'; document.getElementById('bdBox').style.display='block'; }
}

const CURRENCY_RATES = { USD:1, INR:83.2, EUR:0.92, GBP:0.79, JPY:149.5, AUD:1.52, CAD:1.36, AED:3.67 };
const CURRENCY_NAMES = { USD:'US Dollar', INR:'Indian Rupee', EUR:'Euro', GBP:'British Pound', JPY:'Japanese Yen', AUD:'Australian Dollar', CAD:'Canadian Dollar', AED:'UAE Dirham' };
function renderCurrency(body){
  let opts=''; Object.keys(CURRENCY_RATES).forEach(cur=> opts += `<option value="${cur}">${cur} - ${CURRENCY_NAMES[cur]}</option>`);
  body.innerHTML = `
    <div class="convCard">
      <div class="convBox"><label>From</label><select id="curFrom">${opts}</select><input type="number" id="curAmount" value="100"></div>
      <div class="swapBtn" onclick="swapCurrency()">${ico('swap',{size:18})}</div>
      <div class="convBox"><label>To</label><select id="curTo">${opts}</select><input type="text" id="curResult" readonly></div>
      <div class="convNote"><span>${ico('refresh',{size:14,color:'#3B82F6'})}</span><span id="curRateNote">Indicative rates (not live)</span></div>
      <div class="convResultBox"><div class="cLabel" id="curSummaryLabel">100 USD =</div><div class="cVal" id="curSummaryVal">₹8,320.00</div></div>
      <button class="btnCalc blue" style="width:100%;" onclick="calcCurrency()">Convert</button>
    </div>`;
  document.getElementById('curTo').selectedIndex=1;
  calcCurrency();
}
function swapCurrency(){ const f=document.getElementById('curFrom'), t=document.getElementById('curTo'); const tmp=f.value; f.value=t.value; t.value=tmp; calcCurrency(); }
function calcCurrency(){
  const from=document.getElementById('curFrom').value, to=document.getElementById('curTo').value;
  const amt=parseFloat(document.getElementById('curAmount').value)||0;
  const usd = amt/CURRENCY_RATES[from]; const result = usd*CURRENCY_RATES[to];
  document.getElementById('curResult').value = result.toFixed(2);
  document.getElementById('curRateNote').textContent = `1 ${from} = ${(CURRENCY_RATES[to]/CURRENCY_RATES[from]).toFixed(4)} ${to} • Indicative, not live`;
  document.getElementById('curSummaryLabel').textContent = amt+' '+from+' =';
  document.getElementById('curSummaryVal').textContent = result.toLocaleString('en-IN',{maximumFractionDigits:2})+' '+to;
  addHistory('currency', amt+' '+from+' = '+result.toFixed(2)+' '+to);
}

function renderConverter(body,c){

function swapUnit(id){ const f=document.getElementById('unFrom'), t=document.getElementById('unTo'); const tmp=f.value; f.value=t.value; t.value=tmp; calcUnit(id); }
function calcUnit(id){
  const c = CALCULATORS.find(x=>x.id===id);
  const from=document.getElementById('unFrom').value, to=document.getElementById('unTo').value;
  const amt=parseFloat(document.getElementById('unAmount').value)||0;
  const base = amt*c.units[from][1]; const result = base/c.units[to][1];
  document.getElementById('unResult').value = result.toFixed(4);
  addHistory(id, amt+' '+from+' = '+result.toFixed(4)+' '+to);
}
function renderConverterTemp(body){
  body.innerHTML = `
    <div class="convCard">
      <div class="convBox"><label>From</label><select id="tFrom"><option value="c">Celsius</option><option value="f">Fahrenheit</option><option value="k">Kelvin</option></select><input type="number" id="tAmount" value="0"></div>
      <div class="swapBtn" onclick="swapTemp()">${ico('swap',{size:18})}</div>
      <div class="convBox"><label>To</label><select id="tTo"><option value="c">Celsius</option><option value="f" selected>Fahrenheit</option><option value="k">Kelvin</option></select><input type="text" id="tResult" readonly></div>
      <button class="btnCalc" style="width:100%;" onclick="calcTemp()">Convert</button>
    </div>`;
  calcTemp();
}
function swapTemp(){ const f=document.getElementById('tFrom'), t=document.getElementById('tTo'); const tmp=f.value; f.value=t.value; t.value=tmp; calcTemp(); }
function calcTemp(){
  const from=document.getElementById('tFrom').value, to=document.getElementById('tTo').value;
  const val=parseFloat(document.getElementById('tAmount').value)||0;
  let c; if(from==='c') c=val; else if(from==='f') c=(val-32)*5/9; else c=val-273.15;
  let result; if(to==='c') result=c; else if(to==='f') result=c*9/5+32; else result=c+273.15;
  document.getElementById('tResult').value = result.toFixed(2);
  addHistory('tempconv', val+'° '+from.toUpperCase()+' = '+result.toFixed(2)+'° '+to.toUpperCase());
}

let countdownInterval = null;
function renderCountdown(body){
  body.innerHTML = `
    <div class="field"><label>Target Date & Time</label><input type="datetime-local" id="cdTarget"></div>
    <button class="btnCalc" style="width:100%;margin-bottom:16px;" onclick="startCountdown()">Start Countdown</button>
    <div class="resultBox" id="cdBox" style="display:none;"><div class="rLabel">Time Remaining</div><div class="rValue" id="cdValue" style="font-size:20px;">--</div></div>`;
}
function startCountdown(){
  if(countdownInterval) clearInterval(countdownInterval);
  const target = new Date(document.getElementById('cdTarget').value).getTime();
  if(!target) return;
  document.getElementById('cdBox').style.display='block';
  function tick(){
    const now=Date.now(); let diff=target-now;
    if(diff<=0){ document.getElementById('cdValue').textContent='Time reached!'; clearInterval(countdownInterval); return; }
    const d=Math.floor(diff/86400000); diff-=d*86400000;
    const h=Math.floor(diff/3600000); diff-=h*3600000;
    const m=Math.floor(diff/60000); diff-=m*60000;
    const s=Math.floor(diff/1000);
    document.getElementById('cdValue').textContent = `${d}d ${h}h ${m}m ${s}s`;
  }
  tick(); countdownInterval = setInterval(tick,1000);
}

function renderGraph(body){
  body.innerHTML = `
    <div class="field"><label>Function y = f(x)  (use x, e.g. x*x, sin(x))</label><input type="text" id="graphFn" value="x*x"></div>
    <div class="field row"><div><label>X Min</label><input type="number" id="graphMin" value="-10"></div><div><label>X Max</label><input type="number" id="graphMax" value="10"></div></div>
    <button class="btnCalc" style="width:100%;margin-bottom:14px;" onclick="drawGraph()">Plot Graph</button>
    <canvas id="graphCanvas" width="400" height="300" style="width:100%;background:var(--bg);border-radius:14px;"></canvas>`;
  setTimeout(drawGraph,100);
}
function drawGraph(){
  const canvas = document.getElementById('graphCanvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const w=canvas.width, h=canvas.height;
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
  const xmin=parseFloat(document.getElementById('graphMin').value), xmax=parseFloat(document.getElementById('graphMax').value);
  const fnStr = document.getElementById('graphFn').value;
  let f; try{ f = new Function('x','with(Math){return '+fnStr+'}'); }catch(e){ return; }
  const pts=[]; let ymin=Infinity, ymax=-Infinity;
  for(let i=0;i<=200;i++){ const x=xmin+(xmax-xmin)*i/200; let y; try{y=f(x);}catch(e){y=NaN;} if(isFinite(y)){ ymin=Math.min(ymin,y); ymax=Math.max(ymax,y);} pts.push([x,y]); }
  if(!isFinite(ymin)){ymin=-10;ymax=10;}
  if(ymin===ymax){ymin-=1;ymax+=1;}
  ctx.strokeStyle='#E2E4EE'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,h/2); ctx.lineTo(w,h/2); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(w/2,0); ctx.lineTo(w/2,h); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle='#5B2CFF'; ctx.lineWidth=2.5; ctx.beginPath();
  pts.forEach(([x,y],i)=>{
    const px = ((x-xmin)/(xmax-xmin))*w; const py = h-((y-ymin)/(ymax-ymin))*h;
    if(isFinite(py)){ if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(px,py); else ctx.lineTo(px,py); }
  });
  ctx.stroke();
}

function calcProgrammer(){
  const numStr = document.getElementById('progNum').value.trim();
  const base = parseInt(document.getElementById('progBase').value);
  const dec = parseInt(numStr, base);
  if(isNaN(dec)){ document.getElementById('progResult').innerHTML = 'Invalid number for selected base'; return; }
  document.getElementById('progResult').innerHTML =
    `<b>Decimal:</b> ${dec.toString(10)}<br><b>Binary:</b> ${dec.toString(2)}<br><b>Octal:</b> ${dec.toString(8)}<br><b>Hexadecimal:</b> ${dec.toString(16).toUpperCase()}`;
  addHistory('programmer', numStr+' (base '+base+') = '+dec.toString(10)+' dec');
}

function renderKeypadBasic(body){
  body.innerHTML = `<div class="calcExpr" id="basicExprEl"></div><div class="calcDisplay" id="basicDisplayEl">0</div><div class="padGrid" id="basicPadGrid"></div>`;
  const layout = ['C','⌫','%','/','7','8','9','*','4','5','6','-','1','2','3','+','0','.','='];
  const pad = document.getElementById('basicPadGrid');
  layout.forEach(k=>{
    const b=document.createElement('button');
    b.className='padBtn'+(['/','*','-','+','%'].includes(k)?' op':'')+(k==='='?' eq':'')+(k==='C'?' clear':'');
    b.textContent=k; b.onclick=()=>handleBasicKey(k);
    if(k==='=') b.style.gridColumn='span 2';
    pad.appendChild(b);
  });
}
let basicExpr='';
function handleBasicKey(k){
  const disp=document.getElementById('basicDisplayEl'), exprEl=document.getElementById('basicExprEl');
  if(k==='C'){basicExpr='';}
  else if(k==='⌫'){basicExpr=basicExpr.slice(0,-1);}
  else if(k==='='){
    try{ const safe=basicExpr.replace(/[^0-9+\-*/.%() ]/g,''); const result=Function('"use strict";return ('+safe.replace(/%/g,'/100')+')')();
      exprEl.textContent=basicExpr+' ='; basicExpr=String(result); addHistory('basic', exprEl.textContent+' '+basicExpr);
    }catch(e){ basicExpr='Error'; }
  } else { if(basicExpr==='Error') basicExpr=''; basicExpr+=k; }
  disp.textContent=basicExpr||'0';
}

function renderKeypadSci(body){
  body.innerHTML = `<div class="calcExpr" id="sciExprEl"></div><div class="calcDisplay" id="sciDisplayEl">0</div><div class="sciExtraRow" id="sciExtraRowEl"></div><div class="padGrid" id="sciPadGrid"></div>`;
  ['sin','cos','tan','log','√','π','^','ln'].forEach(k=>{
    const b=document.createElement('button'); b.className='padBtn op'; b.style.fontSize='13px'; b.textContent=k; b.onclick=()=>handleSciKey(k);
    document.getElementById('sciExtraRowEl').appendChild(b);
  });
  const layout=['C','⌫','(',')','7','8','9','/','4','5','6','*','1','2','3','-','0','.','=','+'];
  const pad=document.getElementById('sciPadGrid');
  layout.forEach(k=>{
    const b=document.createElement('button');
    b.className='padBtn'+(['/','*','-','+'].includes(k)?' op':'')+(k==='='?' eq':'')+(k==='C'?' clear':'');
    b.textContent=k; b.onclick=()=>handleSciKey(k);
    pad.appendChild(b);
  });
}
let sciExpr='';
function handleSciKey(k){
  const disp=document.getElementById('sciDisplayEl'), exprEl=document.getElementById('sciExprEl');
  if(k==='C'){sciExpr='';}
  else if(k==='⌫'){sciExpr=sciExpr.slice(0,-1);}
  else if(k==='π'){sciExpr+='Math.PI';}
  else if(k==='√'){sciExpr+='Math.sqrt(';}
  else if(k==='^'){sciExpr+='**';}
  else if(k==='sin'){sciExpr+='Math.sin(';}
  else if(k==='cos'){sciExpr+='Math.cos(';}
  else if(k==='tan'){sciExpr+='Math.tan(';}
  else if(k==='log'){sciExpr+='Math.log10(';}
  else if(k==='ln'){sciExpr+='Math.log(';}
  else if(k==='='){
    try{ const result=Function('"use strict";return ('+sciExpr+')')(); exprEl.textContent=sciExpr+' ='; sciExpr=String(result); addHistory('scientific', exprEl.textContent+' '+sciExpr);
    }catch(e){ sciExpr='Error'; }
  } else { if(sciExpr==='Error') sciExpr=''; sciExpr+=k; }
  disp.textContent=sciExpr||'0';
}

/* ============================================================
   INIT
   Boot sequence: load Firebase SDKs (with timeout/retry UI) ->
   init Firebase -> wait for auth state -> wait for splash's
   minimum display time -> navigate. If SDKs fail to load, the
   splash shows a clear retry screen instead of hanging forever.
   ============================================================ */
initStaticIcons();
updateOnboardSlide();
renderChips();

let splashMinTimeDone = false;
let authResolved = false;
let authedUser = null;

function proceedAfterBoot(){
  if(!splashMinTimeDone) return;
  if(authedUser && userData){
    initStreakForUser();
    goTo('dashboardScreen');
  } else if(authedUser && !userData){
    setTimeout(proceedAfterBoot, 250);
  } else {
    onbIndex=0; updateOnboardSlide(); goTo('onboardScreen');
  }
}

window.addEventListener('load', ()=>{
  setTimeout(()=>{ document.getElementById('splashProgressBar').style.width='100%'; }, 100);

  loadFirebaseSDKs().then(()=>{
    initFirebase();
    fbAuth.onAuthStateChanged(user=>{
      authedUser = user;
      authResolved = true;
      if(user){
        currentUser = user;
        loadUserData(user.uid).then(proceedAfterBoot);
      } else {
        proceedAfterBoot();
      }
    });
  }).catch(err=>{
    console.error('Firebase SDK load failed:', err);
    showSplashError();
  });

  setTimeout(()=>{
    splashMinTimeDone = true;
    if(authResolved) proceedAfterBoot();
  }, 2200);
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
